_about: Sir George Webbe Dasent's (1817-1896) English translations of the Norwegian folk tales collected by Peter Christen Asbjørnsen and Jørgen Moe: Popular Tales from the Norse (1859) and Tales from the Fjeld (1874). Dasent is the translator, recorded in each title. Added on relay 6 at the coordinator's ask for the sagas: his Story of Burnt Njal (1861; clean Gutenberg, the proofread transcription of the 1900 one-volume reprint, whose saga text is complete and whose long introduction is abridged) and The Story of Gisli the Outlaw (1866; raw Internet Archive OCR). Clean Gutenberg text unless stated; US public domain.

dasent-popular-tales-from-the-norse: Popular Tales from the Norse, Asbjørnsen and Moe, tr. George Webbe Dasent (1859)
dasent-tales-from-the-fjeld: Tales from the Fjeld, Asbjørnsen, tr. George Webbe Dasent (1874)
dasent-burnt-njal: The Story of Burnt Njal, from the Icelandic of the Njals Saga, tr. George Webbe Dasent (1861; one-volume reprint, 1900, with Dasent's preface abridged)

dasent-gisli-the-outlaw: The Story of Gisli the Outlaw, from the Icelandic, tr. George Webbe Dasent (Edinburgh, 1866)

_excluded.dasent-selection: A Selection from the Norse Tales for the Use of Children (PG 64189): a selection from Popular Tales from the Norse, a duplicate of its stories
_excluded.dasent-njal-duplicate: The Story of Burnt Njal (PG 597, 1995 e-text by Douglas Killings): an older transcription of the same translation; the header does not name Dasent as translator. PG 17919 is held instead
_excluded.dasent-orkneyingers: The Orkneyingers' Saga (Rolls Series, 1894): no usable scan found on this pass
